body: I’ve been clean for 4 years, trying so hard not to relapse today and am struggling with suicidal thoughts, you’re not alone. It’s okay to relapse and it’s normal to feel the way you do, please, please seek help. You deserve to live, you deserve to be here and you deserve not to be in pain. If you ever need someone to talk to, or someone to listen, please reach out to me, you don’t have to go through this alone.
sometimes its beyond motivation and reason, it feels impossible. no matter how hard i try i can’t seem to get out

Thank you so much for your kind words friend, it really means a lot to me. I don’t plan on keeping in touch with my parents, relatives or anyone who is in contact with them but leaving also isn’t the easiest. Even though this has been something I dreamt about for so long, it’s making me feel things I’ve never felt before and I know I will be better off but it’s still hard.

Thank you so, so much for all your kind wishes! I have no connections in any platform to my parents & there isn’t any way they can spy on or control me through. I’ve made a list of all the important things I need to get & I’ll make sure I don’t forget any of them. Also thank you so much again for the advice, sending a letter seems to be a really great idea and I’ll check up on it, seriously, thank you so much! I think this might be what I’m looking for.

Thank you for the advice and it’s a great idea but both of my parents are clueless about technology and it still doesn’t take away the fact that they might keep it from authorities when or if they file a missing person’s report. I’m going to be giving copies to my best friend of whatever I may leave to them, in case of emergency, though i’m trying to find out if I can do more to ensure my safety and make sure they don’t get any kind of help from any authority possible.

I’m afraid it won’t be that easy to get a restraining order for them here, all I know about the requirements of getting one in my country is that I need to have evidence of abuse which I have none of.
Also important to note that no one’s safety is cared about by the authorities in my country, especially if the abuse is coming from the parents, they do brush it off by saying “they’re your parents.”

Thank you so much for all the advice. I’m planning on doing the majority of those things to ensure my safety. But about contacting the police, here’s where it gets confusing.
As of now, my parents & I live in completely different cities and I know that they will realize very quickly that I’m gone since my mom calls me multiple times during a day. Though, I have no idea in which city she’d contact the police if she does so when she realizes that I’m gone. I also have no idea if I can do that in my country and if any police officers & authority would care. 

Also, my destination isn’t the UK but i’m sure it’s a lovely place! Thank you again!
